description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
56 merged commits, 647 files (+15180/-5526). The clone was shallow again on checkout; history was deepened with `git fetch --unshallow` to reach the c043bf2 checkpoint (same as the prior run). Reviewed via 4 parallel domain-focused agents, each verifying every candidate against current merged source: (1) backend services — chat/auth/applications/moderation/cms/notifications/gateway/service-bootstrap/events; (2) observability/ops/audit — the Winston->@ideasquared/log migration, DEPLOY_ENV labelling, alert routing, the /ops/v1 shared contract; (3) frontend apps + lib.*; (4) CI/deploy/scripts/backup/nginx/Docker.

Zero tickets filed — nothing cleared the signal bar. The diff is dominated by infra/CI/deploy/docs plus the cross-cutting logging migration, and most substantive code commits are themselves well-tested fixes to prior review findings (chat permission gating #1662/#1670, concurrent openChat #1663, hardened image URL #1664/#1669, audit-payload schema #1671/#1666, recharts-external/build-from-source #1689/#1691, outbox quarantine #1660).

Verified-clean highlights: no stray console.* in server code (the one in observability/loki-sink.ts:77 is the sink's own documented failure channel, eslint-disabled); no residual Winston; no PII/secrets in migrated log fields (operator login replaced by id throughout ops); no raw-path logging; error objects passed positionally so stacks are preserved; /ops/v1 authz fails closed (ops-team membership or dev-gated local vouch, unlocks 'ignore', PII fields omitted); withTransaction client-release reordering is double-release-safe; backup snapshot scripts keep set -euo pipefail and use empty-array-safe expansion, R2 SSE drop is correct, backups gated off pre-launch with failure-only alerts; deploy build-once/reuse verifies cosign signature before reuse and verify-images is the final gate; E2E shard fan-in blocks merge on any red shard; commitlint Dependabot skip requires both subject shape and signed-off trailer and skips only lint.

Consciously dismissed below-bar (noted, not filed): stale winston-mentioning comments in observability; admin Messages.tsx slightly over-restricts chat controls for a hypothetical rescue-scoped moderator (hide-but-backend-allows direction, and the admin app is route-gated to platform staff with moderate:any anyway); offlineManager returns a fake id if a message is queued in the sub-mount-effect window before currentUserId is set (negligible, chat UI not usable then); per-process extra LokiSink from boot-path one-off loggers (unref'd, once per process); ship.yml dual-trigger deploy TOCTOU (deliberately mitigated by concurrency serialization + deployment-status check).

Overlap checked against all existing ADS labels (Daily Code Review 1473-1479, DevEx/Documentation/Tooling/CI-CD, Security Review, Feature) — no duplicates and nothing new to add. Checkpoint advanced to 8bdd2867.
